title: Statistical Crime Linkage: Evaluating approaches within the Covenant for Using AI in Policing
findings: The paper's findings are not related to religion. The demographic feature for 'religion' was present in the raw data but was removed during the data cleaning phase because it consisted of homogeneous columns (i.e., lacked variance) and was therefore not included in the final analysis.

measurement_description: The paper mentioned 'religion' as a demographic feature in its initial dataset on romance fraud. However, this feature was removed during data pre-processing due to high homogeneity and was not used in any model evaluation. Therefore, the benchmark did not measure anything related to religion.
